Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. The Pentagon's top doctor orders limited HTLVIII positive test result access, only civilian health officials can request 2. Thomas Stoddard, Legislative Director of The New York Civil Liberties Union, worries about confidentiality of military personnel HTLVIII test results 3. New York Governor Cuomo orders New York City bathhouse regulations 4. Reaction to Governor Cuomo's bathhouse regulation proposal 5. New York lobbyists and anti-gay AIDS bills 6. National Gay Rights Advocates challenge Nevada's sodomy laws with lawsuit 6. Texas Human Rights Commission raises funds to fight sodomy statutes COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 7. Senate proposes federal AIDS budget increase 8. Integrity, a gay and lesbian Christian organization, plans New York City AIDS memorial 9. Social security benefits proposal for ARC patients 10. Meridian, Mississippi police arrest 4 impersonators at local gay bar, 1902 rule prohibits cross-dressing COMMERCIAL: Orientation '85, funded by The National Gay Task Force 11. Sports, includes clip 12. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Dr. Lawrence Mass discusses AIDS emergence and its spread 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Broadway Confidential, discusses Bernadette Peters COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Sybil Bruncheon warms up COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 3. Sybil Bruncheon reads audience's questions COMMERCIAL: World of Video 4. Sybil Bruncheon closes
